releaseTitle: Workbench v1.3.0 · Deadline Alerts & Curtain Journal Canvas
changelog: ⏰ Custom Deadline Lead Time: Configure advance notification alerts in hours and minutes before deadlines end
🔔 Active Deadline Watcher: Continuous background detection for tasks, reminders, and timeline events ending soon
🎨 Animated Curtain Journal Canvas: Expandable expression canvas featuring page title, context dictation, and tags
😊 Interactive Mood Slider: Dynamic tactile slider ranging smoothly from Bad (😞) to Super Happy (🤩)
📁 Preserved Journal Archive: Dedicated archive viewer with search, unarchive, and instant tap-to-inspect
🐛 Bug Fixes & Architecture: Removed database unique date constraint allowing multiple daily entries, and fixed premature deadline notifications
